note: Hand-maintained dynamic-event registry. CHANGELIST-INDEPENDENT on purpose: an event's tiers, per-contract point values and rewards are discovered by PLAYING, not by extracting the p4k, so this file must survive dataset regeneration the same way the site's blueprints-extra.json does — whose model it mirrors. Everything unknown is left EMPTY rather than guessed; an invented number here becomes a wrong percentage on Sub's stream.
howToFillIn: 1. `log` MUST equal the subject of the game's own notification, verbatim: "Journal Entry Added: <log>: ". For Siege of Orison the game says "Orison Relief" — NOT "Siege of Orison", which is only the marketing name. Get this wrong and zero progress is ever recorded, silently.

2. `contractPrefixes` is what identifies an event's missions. 🔴 `generators` ALONE CANNOT: CIG uses the single generator "TheBackpocket" for BOTH Orison Relief (13 ORS_ contracts) and Return of XenoThreat (5 RoX_ contracts), so a generator match shows the wrong event's rewards. The key prefix is the only thing that separates them.
3. `contracts` maps a dataset mission key to the event points that contract awards. Add one line per contract as it is MEASURED in game. Do not interpolate.
4. `rewards` gets {tier, name, item} per item as discovered. `name` must equal the log's "Received Blueprint: <name>" EXACTLY — that string is what the owned check matches on.
5. `total` is the event points needed for 100%. Leave null until confirmed.

contractsProvenance.ORS_SA: MEASURED, isolated. Sub's Journal read 17,000; he completed exactly one contract (02:13:25Z Strike Nine Tails Squad, one journal entry) and it read 19,000. Delta 2,000 with nothing else in flight — the only value here obtained the clean way.
contractsProvenance.ORS_MA_HaulingMedium: CONFIRMED by substitution, once Small was measured in isolation (2026-08-22). The five completions on record satisfy 2M + S = 15,000; with S=3000 now MEASURED rather than derived, 2M = 12,000 and M = 6,000 is forced. The equation is no longer underdetermined. Still worth one isolated Medium run to close it directly.
contractsProvenance.ORS_MA_HaulingSmall: MEASURED, isolated. Sub character-reset on 4.10 PTU, wiping his event rep, then rebuilt from scratch. Journal read 12,000; he completed exactly ONE contract (2026-08-22T00:38:39Z, Small Supply Haul) and it read 15,000. Delta 3,000, nothing else in flight. This REPLACES the earlier derivation and kills the M=5000/S=5000 alternative it could not exclude.

events.contractsNote: 🔑 The log carries NO amount — event points ride the server-side ReputationService (see journalEntry in missions-parser.ts). Every number here comes from Sub reading his in-game Journal and differencing. The ONLY sound method is: read the Journal, complete exactly ONE contract, read again — the delta is that contract. Values derived by solving a system are marked as such in contractsProvenance above and should be re-measured that way when convenient. Still unmeasured: ORS_BR, ORS_CA_Small/Medium/Large, ORS_Cr_Small/Medium/Large, ORS_MA_DeliveryPilot, ORS_MA_HaulingLarge, ORS_SWA.

journalReadings.note: Post-character-reset baseline 12,000 -> 15,000. Isolated: notification queue id 21 (completion) and 22 (journal entry) — exactly one of each.

events.journalReadingsNote: Kept so any future correction can be re-derived from the evidence instead of from these conclusions. Each entry is a Journal total and the completions on record at that moment (from Contract Complete lines in the 12473311 logs, one journal entry each). 🔑 THE NOTIFICATION QUEUE ID IS THE DEDUPE KEY. Each notification is logged several times (Added notification, then UpdateNotificationItem for Next/StartFade/Remove) all carrying the SAME bracketed id. Counting raw lines reads one contract as three. Count only `Added notification` lines, and treat the id as the identity — this is what distinguishes a genuine simultaneous double-completion from one notification echoing.
events.rewardsNote: EMPTY until observed in game. Note the three pool-bearing event contracts (ORS_Cr_Small/Medium/Large) all drop `TH-01 Propulsor` (item 1afc0022-b8fc-4174-8687-6dfc5b744b98, chance 1) per the 4.9 dataset — but that is a MISSION-pool drop, not a tier reward, so it does not belong here.
events.knownContractsNote: All 13 ORS_ contracts are already in the shipped 4.9 dataset, verified by exact key match against real 4.10 markers. Givers: Conerstone Developments 6 (CIG's own typo for Cornerstone — match verbatim), Foxwell Enforcement 3, Covalex Independent Contractors 3, Ling Family Hauling 1. All carry rank:null and empty reputationGained, so none of them feed a normal rep track.
